key_insight: vdW confinement in confined epitaxy does more than trap nuclei: it creates strong interfacial mechanical forces that couple to atomic motion in monolayer NbSe2.
engineering_relevance: Engineering the interfacial mechanical landscape could help rationally improve high-throughput growth of high-quality 2D materials in confined epitaxy.
method: Modeling monolayer NbSe2 between c-plane sapphire and h-BN
Force-electronic landscape analysis under vdW confinement
evidence_signal: The abstract reports calculated interfacial forces of +0.070 and -0.04 eV/Å on Nb and Se, producing a unit-cell interaction energy up to 2.4 eV.
watch_item: The conclusion is based on first-principles modeling, so experimental validation of the predicted force-driven mechanism is still needed.
paper_title: Resolving the interfacial mechanical landscape of monolayer NbSe2 grown by confined epitaxy
